prompt:
Create a fresh pose variation of the same Bram mascot for a calm "Try again" illustration. ONE full-body character, true transparent background, approximately 660:570 landscape near-square canvas, comfortably clear margins, no text.

Image 1: original neutral Bram, authoritative for identity and anatomy. Image 2: selected shrug concept, a reference for the emotional direction and matte lilac rendering. Do not copy its fist-shaped hands; the purpose of this variation is a clearer OPEN-HANDED shrug.

Keep original Bram's very broad, squat, bottom-heavy lilac body with low dome continuous into torso, exactly two small ivory horns, tiny feet, glossy dark oval eyes and simple small closed smile. Fine soft matte skin, gentle warm studio lighting, no fur or shiny plastic. Eyes look warmly at viewer. Gentle whole-body tilt, shoulders only slightly lifted, both feet grounded. No brows, nose, tears, blush, teeth, tongue, open mouth or extra markings.

THE NEW GESTURE: Both long thick arms open a little farther to the sides in a relaxed, low shrug. Upper arms hang downward; broad rounded elbows sit low beside his belly. Thick curved forearms angle outward and upward. Each arm ends in a SOFT OPEN UPTURNED MITTEN held almost horizontally, like offering an empty open hand. We should see the broad upper palm surface: a shallow gently concave dish, with a rounded upward-curving outer end representing all fingers together as one continuous lobe. This is an open mitten, NOT a sphere with a thumb stuck on it. A short thick rounded thumb lobe lies low along the inner side of the mitten, sideways, not pointing upward. NO clenched fists, no balls facing the camera, no thumbs-up. No individual fingers, finger grooves, glove cuffs, fingernails, skeletal joints or human hand realism. Keep Bram's arms substantial and softly rounded in three dimensions; the open mitten has real depth, not a thin fin or flattened paddle.

Position both palms lower than his cheeks with one palm slightly higher. Hands sit outside the sides of his body enough that the shrug silhouette is readable, but gesture stays compact and welcoming. Torso stays full and broad, no dents or pinching at arm roots. Both limbs visibly connect smoothly and have the same long chunky volume as original Bram. His posture should say "a little hiccup; let's try once more" with patient warmth.

Only original periwinkle/lilac, ivory horns, dark eyes and mouth, and natural shading. No objects or added colour: no receipt, arrows, question marks, checkmarks, hearts, confetti, streamers, bubbles, costume, accessories, background, floor plane or card. Small soft neutral translucent contact shadow under feet. Clean antialiased alpha edges without white flecks or bright matte fringe. Preserve original character identity. Produce a single finished concept illustration; no labels or comparison panels.
refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserving character refinement.
Edit this exact Bram shrug illustration. Make ONE change only: REMOVE BOTH THUMBS, the small purple protrusions attached to the outer sides of his two raised arm ends.

Replace each thumb connection with a smooth uninterrupted rounded contour. Each arm should end in a simple full, plump, softly rounded oval cap, with no fingers, digits, thumb bumps, lobes, notches, knuckles, seams, palm lines or human-hand anatomy. Preserve the thick three-dimensional volume of his long arms; do not flatten them into fins or paddles. Keep both arm ends turned gently upward in exactly the same relaxed asymmetric shrug pose. The gentle shrug should read entirely through the orientation of the rounded arms.

Keep EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: Bram's full broad lilac body, original body proportions, shoulder attachments, arm lengths and thickness, slight body tilt, exact eye shape and highlights, small closed smile, two ivory horns, tiny planted feet, subtle matte skin texture, lilac and cream colours, warm lighting, small ground shadow, framing, scale and canvas dimensions. Do not remove or alter the ivory horns. No new objects, symbols, lettering or decorations.

Preserve genuine alpha transparency and antialiased edges. Output one full-body Bram in the same composition as the input, with only those two purple thumb protrusions removed.
notes: User-approved relaxed shrug with smooth rounded arm ends and no thumbs, copied unchanged from the final generation. The refinement edited the preceding shrug concept to remove its two thumb protrusions. Only the approved final pose is retained in the repository. One transparent PNG is used in both themes.
inputNotes: The pose prompt used the neutral identity reference and an earlier shrug concept; the refinement prompt edited that pose to remove its thumbs. Intermediate concepts remain outside the repository.
